test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: With which of the following does Article 72 of the Constitution of India deal?

options.text: Composition and jurisdiction of Supreme Court of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pardoning power of the President**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Article 72 of the Constitution of India deals with the **pardoning power of the President**.
 
• The President of India has the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment or to suspend, remit or commute the sentence of any person convicted of any offense.
 
• This power is exercised in cases where the punishment or sentence is by a court-martial, the punishment or sentence is for an offense against any law relating to a matter to which the executive power of the Union extends, or in all cases where the sentence is a sentence of death.
 
• This power is a part of the sovereign power of the President and is independent of the judiciary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Composition and jurisdiction of Supreme Court of India**

 
 
• The Supreme Court of India is the highest judicial forum and final court of appeal under the Constitution of India.
 
• It comprises the Chief Justice of India and a number of other judges as determined by Parliament.
 
• The Supreme Court has extensive jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases as well as constitutional matters.
 
 
 
• **Right to freedom of speech**
 
 
• The right to freedom of speech is guaranteed by Article 19(1)(a) of the Constitution of India.
 
• It allows citizens to express their thoughts and opinions freely, subject to reasonable restrictions.
 
 
 
• **Appointment of Prime Minister**
 
 
• The Prime Minister of India is appointed by the President of India.
 
• The leader of the majority party in the Lok Sabha (House of the People) is usually appointed as the Prime Minister.
